scope: v0.9.1 uniform serial hot-state inference benchmark over every catalogue entry

device_policy.full: catalogue device: cuda = TabPFN residual components on CUDA (hard failure without CUDA); cpu = CPU only. All other numerical work runs on the pinned CPU core with 1 thread.
device_policy.point_only: CPU only for every entry with point_only_supported; tabpfn_joint runs TabPFN on CPU.
device_policy.xgb: XGBoost n_jobs forced to 1 for timing (configs/main.yaml keeps 4 for normal runs; outputs identical).

state_selection: folds 0/1/2, two validation sites each, seed 17, budgets 5/13
timing: perf_counter, torch.cuda.synchronize at timing boundaries for CUDA paths; fresh condition every repeat
excluded: data loading, input DataFrame copies, output checks against the reference, evaluation and calibration
initialization: One construction + explicit initialize() (TabPFN weight load) per path and fold, separate from warm inference. Framework import and CUDA context start-up are outside timing.
quantiles: median/p95 over 3 repeats x 12 states; descriptive warm-state samples, not a stable tail estimate
memory: RSS is the absolute process working set after inference; CUDA peak allocated includes live weights
remaining_timing_limits: Entries run sequentially in the recorded order; CPU/GPU frequencies are not locked; order effects remain possible.
output_check: Each state output compared with artifacts/evaluation/reference_predictions.parquet after timing (output_checks.csv; summary columns matches_reference etc.).
